snippet.title: Construction Store Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Think running a hardware store is boring? Think again.

In Construction Store Simulator, you'll handle customer service, manage inventory, expand your shop 📦 and keep an eye out for shoplifters trying to steal your merchandise. Catch them in the act or watch your profits walk out the door.

Demo available January 26, 2026.

Add to wishlist and give it a try. 🛒
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891470/Construction_Store_Simulator
 
#ConstructionStoreSimulator #SimulationGames #IndieGames
